root_idea.summary: The root centers on pebbles or small stones as a kind of earth material.
root_idea.development: From the basic notion of pebbles come meanings involving pelting, pebble-bearing winds, pebble-strewn places, fuel thrown into a fire, and several derived or figurative usages.

senses.definition: A pebble-bearing or stone-casting wind or storm.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrences, the active participle is used substantivally for a violent wind or storm that raises, carries, or casts pebbles, sometimes together with dust.

senses.definition: Fuel or firewood cast into a fire; in the Quranic expression, the fuel of Hell.
senses.usage_conditions: The form occurs in the construction حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ, referring to material used as fuel for the fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To throw or pelt with pebbles; more generally, to pelt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The direct object may be a person or thing being pelted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of wind, to cast, drive along, or tear up pebbles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the wind as subject and pebbles as what it carries or displaces.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To spread or strew pebbles over a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of spreading pebbles in a mosque or other designated place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To throw material or firewood into a fire; to kindle or make a fire blaze with it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may take the firewood or other material as object, with the fire understood or expressed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten away in flight or turn away from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a figurative branch describing rapid withdrawal, especially from a companion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go away in or into the country or land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as a usage equivalent to going away through the land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To discharge excrement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported interpretation of the same expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break out with measles or a similar spotted cutaneous fever.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a person's skin or body when affected by the eruption.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stop or sleep at al-Muḥaṣṣab, the pebble-strewn place or route associated with the pilgrimage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A pilgrimage-related usage referring especially to stopping there for a short time on the return from Minā to Mecca.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse or other beast, to strike up pebbles while running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject is an animal whose movement scatters or lifts pebbles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pelt one another with pebbles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Stones or pebbles; specifically, a stone that is thrown.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the ordinary stone-related noun, distinct from the Quranic fire-fuel usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pebbly; containing or abounding in pebbles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of land or a place with many pebbles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single throwing of pebbles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may also occur in the conventional expression for the night following the pilgrimage days of stoning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The night following the days of the pilgrimage stoning rites.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional calendrical expression referring to the night after the days known as Ayyām al-Tashrīq.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Measles or a similar spotted cutaneous eruption.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is also reported by some authorities for smallpox, but the primary descriptions identify a measles-like eruption.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pebbles or small pebbles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quasi-plural noun for pebbles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thrower or pelter of stones; figuratively, a calumniator in an idiomatic expression.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the human-agent use of the active participle, distinct from its Quranic wind or storm use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A punishment from God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the destructive-storm sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dust containing pebbles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal description of pebble-laden dust.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clouds that cast down snow or hail.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is applied to clouds because of what they cast down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pebbles borne along by the wind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the pebbles themselves when carried by wind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Small particles of snow or hail scattered about.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transferred use based on the scattering of small particles like pebbles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large number of men on foot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare reported usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affected by measles or the cutaneous eruption called ḥaṣbah.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial description of a person affected by the disease.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of milk, thick or congealed so that it does not yield butter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare reported lexical use explained through the image of becoming hard like pebbles.

cautions: The bare noun حَصَبٌ has broader Classical senses including stones, but its supplied Quranic occurrence is the fire-and-fuel expression.
The active participle حَاصِبٌ has both a human-agent sense and a wind-or-storm sense; the Quranic form is represented here by the latter.
